sections.heading: Ambala Cantt: India's Scientific Instruments Cluster
paragraphs: Ambala Cantonment is home to one of India's best-known scientific instruments clusters. The Ambala Scientific Instruments Manufacturers' Association has described more than 2,000 manufacturing units in Ambala Cantonment producing glassware, electronic products, educational instruments and scientific apparatus, with annual turnover exceeding Rs 3,000 crore.

The cluster is under pressure from cheaper imports, and its association has raised the quality of science kits procured for schools with the Union government. The firms moving up the value chain are those building complete equipment for pharmaceutical, hospital and research laboratories, and that is where certified, electropolished tube comes in.

sections.heading: Electropolished Tube for Ambala's Laboratory and Pharma Equipment Makers
paragraphs: Several Ambala Cantt firms list stainless steel autoclaves, sterilisers and laboratory equipment. Once an instrument is sold to a pharmaceutical QC lab or a GMP plant, its wetted parts are inspected like any other process equipment. Steam, purified-water and drain lines inside an autoclave, water still or lab water system are exactly where an electropolished 316L bore helps: it resists pitting from hot steam, releases deposits, and gives the buyer's validation team a documented surface finish.

For export models, buyers increasingly ask for the material certificate behind every wetted part. We supply small-bore tube from 6.35 mm OD upward, so an instrument maker can buy the same documented grade for internal plumbing that a pharma plant buys for its loops.
Quote the instrument model and its pressure and temperature rating with your enquiry, so we can confirm the wall thickness is adequate for the steam duty before you build a batch.

sections.heading: Choosing Grade and Finish for Instrument Builds
bullets: Steam and condensate inside autoclaves and sterilisers: 316L, SF4 electropolished where the customer is pharma or hospital CSSD.
Purified or distilled water outlets on water stills and lab water systems: 316L SF4, sloped to drain.
Educational and general laboratory apparatus with no product contact: 304 with a bright or SF1 finish keeps cost down.
Chloride-bearing media, such as saline or disinfectant solutions: 316L minimum; discuss duplex if temperatures are high.

sections.heading: Request a Quote: Tube for Ambala Instrument Manufacturers
bullets: List each size as OD × wall, including small bores such as 6.35 × 0.89 mm and 9.53 × 0.89 mm used inside equipment.
Give quantity per size; small mixed orders for instrument builds are normal and should be stated as such.
Say whether the tube must be cut to your drawing lengths or bent, and whether matching clamp ferrules or compression ends are needed.
Name the end market (Indian pharma QC lab, hospital, export customer) so documentation matches their audit.
Every lot ships with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number and PMI records; electropolished lots also carry an internal Ra report.

sections.heading: Delivery to Ambala
paragraphs: Ambala is a long-haul road delivery from our Taloja MIDC works; dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation. ICD Ludhiana is the nearest listed container gateway for export shipments of finished instruments.
